transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1062 Sheffield Run Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1062 Sheffield Run Drive, just me here, no one else, water’s not in the house, and I’m totally fine—no need for any truck, boat, or extra seats, I’m good on my own.
Thanks for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Just me here, all good, no one else around, and I’m totally fine on my own—no need for help or anything.

Thanks for letting us know you're okay. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just me, all good, no one here who can’t leave on their own, not even a wheelchair or anything like that—just me, totally fine, no worries.
Understood, you’re alone and fine. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just me here by myself, everything’s dry and I’m good to go.
You’re alone and everything’s dry — no water inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Yeah, I’m all good here, no water inside at all, just me, and I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to give anyone a ride—sorry, not much I can do.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I don’t have any free seats in a vehicle—just me here, no one else, and the water’s not even inside the house, so no need for a ride out.
Understood, you’re alone and water hasn’t entered your home. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just me, no water in yet, and I’m good, no need for help or anything.
Understood, you’re alone and no water in yet. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
